$comment: The updater signer (#5761): the standalone Tauri CLI release binary the sign-updater job of release.yml signs the in-app updater bundles with, so that job installs no project dependencies and compiles nothing. updater-signing.sh install-signer downloads the asset for the host and refuses it unless its SHA-256 matches. Bump version and every sha256 together (gh api repos/tauri-apps/tauri/releases/tags/tauri-cli-v<version> --jq '.assets[] | [.name, .digest]'); the version must support `signer sign --app-version`.
